title: Megoldandó feladatok és fenntarthatóság (Tasks to Be Solved & Sustainability)
grammar: Predictive Registers, Future Participles (-andó/-endő) & Societal Discourse in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can name a task that is still ahead with a participle in -andó/-endő.
I can say that something is possible with -ható/-hető, for example megvalósítható.
I can explain what sustainability and renewal mean.
I can say that innovation helps to solve problems.
